Class DeckController

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.controller.DeckController
@Controller public class DeckController extends Object
This controller manages all deck-related actions, including creating, deleting, viewing, and editing decks. It interacts with the DeckDAO, PlayerDAO, and CardDAO to retrieve and update deck and card data.
Author:
Adan, Oihan, Asier, Brayan

      @GetMapping("/deckcreate") public String showDeckCreate(org.springframework.ui.Model model, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session)

    • insertDeck

      @PostMapping("/deckcreate") public String insertDeck(org.springframework.ui.Model model, org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.support.RedirectAttributes redirectAttributes, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, @ModelAttribute com.dami.tcg.modelo.Deck deck)
